name: Amicro
summary: React library of micro-interaction, transition and card components, added with the shadcn CLI.
description: A curated collection of React micro-interactions, transition components and card layouts powered by Motion. Components include an interactive 3D carousel, a CoverFlow carousel and dither chart, heatmap and bar chart cards. Items install from a shadcn registry, either by direct raw URL or through the @amicro namespace.
contains: 6 shadcn registry items: carousels, dither charts and card layouts
sample components: Interactive 3D Carousel, CoverFlow Carousel, Dither Donut Chart, Activity Dither Heatmap
installs with the shadcn CLI: direct raw URL or @amicro namespace mapping
ships motion primitives, custom hooks and spring presets
